text: The devil sued a billionaire for stealing his business model. His argument: I invented making people sign contracts they never read. Exhibit A: terms and conditions, ninety thousand words long. The billionaire's lawyer opened one page. Page eighty four. In two thousand nine, the devil had signed up for free shipping. He clicked I agree. He lost. Now he pays fourteen ninety nine a month. Forever. Have you ever read the terms? Don't lie.
